decision: Implement comprehensive overhaul of the Economy tab, Group view layout, observable debt timeline chart, stream sorting, multi-criteria expense filters, locale-aware amount parser, and database contract fixes.

proposed_actions.action: Fix locale-aware number parsing in CurrencyInputHelper and UnifiedTransactionModal
Set userId = auth.uid() in ExpenseServiceCached.insert() to prevent database key violation
Add in-modal error banners and bypass occluded ScaffoldMessenger SnackBars
Enforce date descending sort on _groupExpensesStream and _mergeStreams in ExpenseServiceCached
Adopt SolducciAppBar with ContextSwitcher in EconomyHubView and reorder Group layout
Implement ExpenseFilterCriteria engine and redesign ExpenseList UI
Add payer and split management controls to _EditExpenseSheet

claims: Replacing replaceAll('.', '') restores standard dot decimal inputs such as '31.4'.
Populating user_id with auth.uid() on group expense insertion satisfies the NOT NULL constraint.
Applying descending sort at stream ingress fixes oldest-first order without UI race conditions.
alternatives: Fl_chart library for debt timeline (rejected due to zero-center calibration friction)
Ad-hoc title row for ContextSwitcher (rejected due to header button crowding)
Client-side sorting in EconomyHubView only (rejected in favor of service-layer stream sorting)
limitations: Sparse group expense history requires step-line interpolation to prevent misleading slopes.
Expenses paid by other members must never have a personal wallet assigned.
